title: Projection tensor comparison for a specified section and unit
statement: Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative condensed ring and let $D(X)$ denote the unbounded derived category of its internal modules [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull], equipped with the fixed native tensor [def-sfb-projective-diagonal-pullback]. For arbitrary schemes $X,S$, arrows $g:X\to S$, $p:S\to X$, a specified natural isomorphism $s:Lg^*Lp^*\simeq\mathrm{id}_{D(X)}$, an object $U\in D(X)$ and an isomorphism $e:U\simeq\mathbf1_{D(X)}$, define $c_M:Lp^*M\otimes Rg_*U\to Rg_*M$ by the fixed canonical projection [def-sfb-projective-diagonal-composition] followed by $Rg_*((s_M\otimes e);\rho_M)$. This is explicit data for every $M\in D(X)$; no invertibility of $c_M$ is asserted and no geometric section equation is required beyond the supplied comparison $s$.
